FUNCTION Z_CODEX_MCP_DDIC_API
  IMPORTING
    VALUE(IV_OPERATION) LIKE BAPIRET2-PARAMETER
    VALUE(IV_OBJECT_TYPE) LIKE TADIR-OBJECT OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IV_PROGRAM) LIKE TRDIR-NAME OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IV_SCREEN) LIKE D020S-DNUM OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IV_TRANSACTION) LIKE TSTC-TCODE OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IV_DESCRIPTION) LIKE TSTCT-TTEXT OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IV_PACKAGE) LIKE TADIR-DEVCLASS OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IV_REQUEST) LIKE E070-TRKORR OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IS_HEADER) LIKE D020S OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IV_OBJECT_NAME) LIKE TADIR-OBJ_NAME OPTIONAL
    VALUE(IV_EXPECTED_VERSION) LIKE SY-MSGV1 OPTIONAL
  EXPORTING
    VALUE(EV_STATUS) LIKE SY-MSGTY
    VALUE(EV_CODE) LIKE SY-MSGV1
    VALUE(EV_MESSAGE) LIKE BAPIRET2-MESSAGE
    VALUE(EV_VERSION) LIKE SY-MSGV1
    VALUE(ES_HEADER) LIKE D020S
    VALUE(EV_DYNPROTEXT) LIKE D020T-DTXT
  TABLES
    CT_FIELDS LIKE D021S
    CT_FLOWLOGIC LIKE D022S
    CT_PARAMS LIKE D023S
    ET_TCODES LIKE TSTC
    ET_GUI_ATTRIBUTES LIKE TSTCC
    IT_SOURCE LIKE ABAPTXT255.



  DATA ls_dd01v TYPE dd01v.
  DATA lt_dd07v TYPE TABLE OF dd07v.
  DATA ls_dd07v TYPE dd07v.
  DATA ls_dd04v TYPE dd04v.
  DATA ls_dd02v TYPE dd02v.
  DATA ls_dd09v TYPE dd09v.
  DATA lt_dd03p TYPE TABLE OF dd03p.
  DATA ls_dd03p TYPE dd03p.
  DATA ls_dd40v TYPE dd40v.
  DATA ls_current_dd01v TYPE dd01v.
  DATA lt_current_dd07v TYPE TABLE OF dd07v.
  DATA ls_current_dd04v TYPE dd04v.
  DATA ls_current_dd02v TYPE dd02v.
  DATA ls_current_dd09v TYPE dd09v.
  DATA lt_current_dd03p TYPE TABLE OF dd03p.
  DATA lt_append_dd03p TYPE TABLE OF dd03p.
  DATA lt_checked_dd03p TYPE TABLE OF dd03p.
  DATA ls_compare_dd03p TYPE dd03p.
  DATA ls_current_dd40v TYPE dd40v.
  DATA lt_current_dd42v TYPE TABLE OF dd42v.
  DATA lt_current_dd43v TYPE TABLE OF dd43v.
  DATA lt_dd42v TYPE TABLE OF dd42v.
  DATA ls_dd42v TYPE dd42v.
  DATA lt_dd43v TYPE TABLE OF dd43v.
  DATA ls_dd43v TYPE dd43v.
  DATA ls_tadir TYPE tadir.
  DATA ls_source TYPE abaptxt255.
  DATA lv_kind TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_index_text TYPE string.
  DATA lv_index TYPE i.
  DATA lv_property TYPE c LENGTH 30.
  DATA lv_value TYPE string.
  DATA lv_object_type TYPE tadir-object.
  DATA: BEGIN OF ls_corr_object,
    objtype TYPE e071-object,
    objname TYPE e071-obj_name,
  END OF ls_corr_object.
  DATA lv_tadir_type TYPE tadir-object.
  DATA lv_state_type TYPE ddobjtyp.
  DATA lv_gotstate TYPE ddgotstate.
  DATA lv_active_state TYPE ddgotstate.
  DATA lv_current_version TYPE c LENGTH 14.
  DATA lv_existing TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_write TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_delete TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_append TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_patch TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_changed TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_key_closed TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_current_has_mandt TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_final_has_mandt TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_mode TYPE c LENGTH 1.
  DATA lv_rc TYPE sy-subrc.
  DATA lv_recorded_request TYPE trkorr.
  DATA lv_ddic_name TYPE ddobjname.
  DATA lv_as4date TYPE as4date.
  DATA lv_as4time TYPE as4time.
  DATA lv_deleted TYPE ddbool_d.
  DATA lt_object_refs TYPE TABLE OF dcobjbez.
  DATA ls_domain_dd01v TYPE dd01v.
  DATA lt_domain_dd07v TYPE TABLE OF dd07v.
  DATA ls_reference_dd04v TYPE dd04v.
  DATA lv_reference_state TYPE ddgotstate.
  DATA lv_text_length TYPE i.
  DATA lv_append_count TYPE i.
  DATA lv_field_count TYPE i.
  DATA lv_current_field_count TYPE i.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_value> TYPE dd07v.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <ls_field> TYPE dd03p.
  FIELD-SYMBOLS <lv_component> TYPE any.
  DEFINE add_payload.
    CLEAR ls_source.
    lv_index_text = &2.
    CONDENSE lv_index_text NO-GAPS.
    lv_value = &4.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '%' IN lv_value WITH '%25'.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '|' IN lv_value WITH '%7C'.
    CONCATENATE &1 lv_index_text &3 lv_value
      INTO ls_source-line
      SEPARATED BY '|'.
    APPEND ls_source TO it_source.
  END-OF-DEFINITION.
  CASE iv_operation.
    WHEN 'READ_DOMAIN'.
      lv_object_type = 'DOMA'.
    WHEN 'UPSERT_DOMAIN'.
      lv_object_type = 'DOMA'.
      lv_write = 'X'.
    WHEN 'READ_DATA_ELEMENT'.
      lv_object_type = 'DTEL'.
    WHEN 'UPSERT_DATA_ELEMENT'.
      lv_object_type = 'DTEL'.
      lv_write = 'X'.
    WHEN 'READ_STRUCTURE'.
      lv_object_type = 'STRU'.
    WHEN 'UPSERT_STRUCTURE'.
      lv_object_type = 'STRU'.
      lv_write = 'X'.
    WHEN 'READ_TRANSPARENT_TABLE'.
      lv_object_type = 'TABL'.
    WHEN 'CREATE_TRANSPARENT_TABLE'.
      lv_object_type = 'TABL'.
      lv_write = 'X'.
    WHEN 'APPEND_TRANSPARENT_TABLE_FIELDS'.
      lv_object_type = 'TABL'.
      lv_write = 'X'. lv_append = 'X'.
    WHEN 'PATCH_TRANSPARENT_TABLE_FIELDS'.
      lv_object_type = 'TABL'.
      lv_write = 'X'. lv_patch = 'X'.
    WHEN 'READ_TABLE_TYPE'.
      lv_object_type = 'TTYP'.
    WHEN 'UPSERT_TABLE_TYPE'.
      lv_object_type = 'TTYP'.
      lv_write = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DELETE_DOMAIN'.
      lv_object_type = 'DOMA'.
      lv_write = 'X'. lv_delete = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DELETE_DATA_ELEMENT'.
      lv_object_type = 'DTEL'.
      lv_write = 'X'. lv_delete = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DELETE_STRUCTURE'.
      lv_object_type = 'STRU'.
      lv_write = 'X'. lv_delete = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DELETE_TRANSPARENT_TABLE'.
      lv_object_type = 'TABL'.
      lv_write = 'X'. lv_delete = 'X'.
    WHEN 'DELETE_TABLE_TYPE'.
      lv_object_type = 'TTYP'.
      lv_write = 'X'. lv_delete = 'X'.
    WHEN OTHERS.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'OPERATION_NOT_SUPPORTED'.
      ev_message = 'Unsupported DDIC operation'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
  ENDCASE.
  IF iv_object_name IS INITIAL.
    ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'OBJECT_NAME_REQUIRED'.
    ev_message = 'DDIC object name is required'.
    ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  lv_ddic_name = iv_object_name.
  IF lv_write = 'X'.
    IF iv_object_name(1) <> 'Z'
       AND iv_object_name(1) <> 'Y'.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'CUSTOMER_OBJECT_REQUIRED'.
      ev_message = 'Only Z or Y DDIC objects are writable'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    lv_value = iv_object_name.
    CONDENSE lv_value NO-GAPS.
    IF lv_value CN 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_'.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'OBJECT_NAME_INVALID'.
      ev_message = 'Invalid customer DDIC object name'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_package IS INITIAL OR iv_package = '$TMP'
       OR iv_request IS INITIAL
       OR ( iv_description IS INITIAL AND lv_delete IS INITIAL
         AND lv_append IS INITIAL AND lv_patch IS INITIAL ).
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'WRITE_INPUT_REQUIRED'.
      ev_message = 'Description package and request required'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_write = 'X'.
    LOOP AT it_source INTO ls_source.
      CLEAR: lv_kind, lv_index_text, lv_property, lv_value.
      SPLIT ls_source-line AT '|' INTO lv_kind lv_index_text
        lv_property lv_value.
      IF lv_index_text IS INITIAL
         OR lv_index_text CN '0123456789'.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PAYLOAD_INVALID'.
        ev_message = 'DDIC payload index is invalid'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      lv_index = lv_index_text.
      TRANSLATE lv_property TO UPPER CASE.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '%7C' IN lv_value WITH '|'.
      REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '%25' IN lv_value WITH '%'.
      IF lv_index <= 0 OR lv_property IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PAYLOAD_INVALID'.
        ev_message = 'DDIC payload is invalid'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      UNASSIGN <lv_component>.
      CASE lv_kind.
        WHEN 'H'.
          IF lv_index <> 1.
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PAYLOAD_INVALID'.
            ev_message = 'Header index must be one'.
            ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          CASE lv_object_type.
            WHEN 'DOMA'.
              IF lv_property <> 'DATATYPE'
                 AND lv_property <> 'LENG'
                 AND lv_property <> 'OUTPUTLEN'
                 AND lv_property <> 'DECIMALS'
                 AND lv_property <> 'LOWERCASE'
                 AND lv_property <> 'SIGNFLAG'
                 AND lv_property <> 'ENTITYTAB'
                 AND lv_property <> 'CONVEXIT'.
                ev_status = 'E'.
                ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
                ev_message = 'Domain property not allowed'.
                ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'DATATYPE'
                 AND lv_value <> 'CHAR' AND lv_value <> 'NUMC'
                 AND lv_value <> 'DEC' AND lv_value <> 'DATS'
                 AND lv_value <> 'TIMS'.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DATATYPE_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Unsupported domain data type'.
                ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF ( lv_property = 'LENG'
                   OR lv_property = 'OUTPUTLEN'
                   OR lv_property = 'DECIMALS' )
                 AND ( lv_value IS INITIAL
                   OR lv_value CN '0123456789' ).
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'NUMBER_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Domain length or decimals invalid'.
                ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF ( lv_property = 'LOWERCASE'
                   OR lv_property = 'SIGNFLAG' )
                 AND lv_value IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_value <> 'X'.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FLAG_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Domain flag must be X or empty'.
                ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
                OF STRUCTURE ls_dd01v TO <lv_component>.
            WHEN 'DTEL'.
              IF lv_property <> 'DOMNAME'
                 AND lv_property <> 'REPTEXT'
                 AND lv_property <> 'SCRTEXT_S'
                 AND lv_property <> 'SCRTEXT_M'
                 AND lv_property <> 'SCRTEXT_L'.
                ev_status = 'E'.
                ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
                ev_message = 'Data element property not allowed'.
                ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'DOMNAME'
                 AND lv_value CN
                   'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_/'.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Invalid domain reference'.
                ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
                OF STRUCTURE ls_dd04v TO <lv_component>.
            WHEN 'TTYP'.
              IF lv_property <> 'ROWTYPE'.
                ev_status = 'E'.
                ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
                ev_message = 'Table type property not allowed'.
                ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_value IS INITIAL OR lv_value CN
                   'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_/'.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Invalid table row type reference'.
                ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
                OF STRUCTURE ls_dd40v TO <lv_component>.
            WHEN 'TABL'.
              IF lv_property <> 'CONTFLAG'
                 AND lv_property <> 'MAINFLAG'
                 AND lv_property <> 'TABKAT'
                 AND lv_property <> 'TABART'
                 AND lv_property <> 'BUFALLOW'
                 AND lv_property <> 'PUFFERUNG'.
                ev_status = 'E'.
                ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
                ev_message = 'Table property not allowed'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'TABART'
                 AND lv_value <> 'APPL0'
                 AND lv_value <> 'APPL1'
                 AND lv_value <> 'APPL2'.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DATA_CLASS_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Invalid table data class'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'CONTFLAG'
                 AND lv_value <> 'A' AND lv_value <> 'C'
                 AND lv_value <> 'L' AND lv_value <> 'G'
                 AND lv_value <> 'E' AND lv_value <> 'S'
                 AND lv_value <> 'W'.
                ev_status = 'E'.
                ev_code = 'DELIVERY_CLASS_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Invalid table delivery class'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'MAINFLAG'
                 AND lv_value IS NOT INITIAL
                 AND lv_value <> 'X' AND lv_value <> 'R'.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FLAG_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Invalid table maintenance flag'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'TABKAT'
                 AND ( lv_value IS INITIAL
                   OR lv_value CN '01234' ).
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'NUMBER_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Invalid table size category'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'BUFALLOW' AND lv_value <> 'N'.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'BUFFER_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'New tables must disable buffering'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'PUFFERUNG'
                 AND lv_value IS NOT INITIAL.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'BUFFER_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'New tables must disable buffering'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'CONTFLAG'
                 OR lv_property = 'MAINFLAG'.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
                  OF STRUCTURE ls_dd02v TO <lv_component>.
              ELSE.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
                  OF STRUCTURE ls_dd09v TO <lv_component>.
              ENDIF.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PAYLOAD_INVALID'.
              ev_message = 'Structure has no header payload'.
              ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
          ENDCASE.
        WHEN 'V'.
          IF lv_object_type <> 'DOMA'
             OR ( lv_property <> 'DOMVALUE_L'
             AND lv_property <> 'DOMVALUE_H'
             AND lv_property <> 'DDTEXT' ).
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
            ev_message = 'Fixed value property not allowed'.
            ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          WHILE lines( lt_dd07v ) < lv_index.
            CLEAR ls_dd07v. APPEND ls_dd07v TO lt_dd07v.
          ENDWHILE.
          READ TABLE lt_dd07v ASSIGNING <ls_value>
            INDEX lv_index.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
            OF STRUCTURE <ls_value> TO <lv_component>.
        WHEN 'F'.
          IF lv_object_type <> 'STRU' AND lv_object_type <> 'TABL'.
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
            ev_message = 'Field payload not allowed'.
            ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF lv_property <> 'FIELDNAME'
             AND lv_property <> 'ROLLNAME'
             AND ( lv_object_type <> 'TABL'
               OR ( lv_property <> 'KEYFLAG'
                 AND lv_property <> 'NOTNULL' ) ).
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
            ev_message = 'Table field property not allowed'.
            ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF lv_property = 'FIELDNAME'
             AND ( lv_value IS INITIAL OR lv_value CN
               'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_' ).
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELD_VALUE_INVALID'.
            ev_message = 'Invalid structure field name'.
            ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF lv_property = 'ROLLNAME'
             AND ( lv_value IS INITIAL OR lv_value CN
               'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_/' ).
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_INVALID'.
            ev_message = 'Invalid data element reference'.
            ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF ( lv_property = 'KEYFLAG'
               OR lv_property = 'NOTNULL' )
             AND lv_value IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_value <> 'X'.
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FLAG_INVALID'.
            ev_message = 'Table field flag must be X or empty'.
            ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF lv_object_type = 'TABL'
             AND lv_append IS INITIAL
             AND lv_patch IS INITIAL
             AND lv_property = 'NOTNULL' AND lv_value <> 'X'.
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'NOTNULL_REQUIRED'.
            ev_message = 'Transparent table fields must be not null'.
            ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          WHILE lines( lt_dd03p ) < lv_index.
            CLEAR ls_dd03p. APPEND ls_dd03p TO lt_dd03p.
          ENDWHILE.
          READ TABLE lt_dd03p ASSIGNING <ls_field>
            INDEX lv_index.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
            OF STRUCTURE <ls_field> TO <lv_component>.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PAYLOAD_INVALID'.
          ev_message = 'Unknown DDIC payload row type'.
          ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDCASE.
      IF <lv_component> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PROPERTY_INVALID'.
        ev_message = 'Unknown DDIC payload property'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      <lv_component> = lv_value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_object_type = 'STRU'.
    lv_tadir_type = 'TABL'.
    lv_state_type = 'TABL'.
  ELSE.
    lv_tadir_type = lv_object_type.
    lv_state_type = lv_object_type.
  ENDIF.
  CLEAR: lv_gotstate, lv_current_version, lv_existing.
  CASE lv_object_type.
    WHEN 'DOMA'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd01v_wa = ls_current_dd01v
        TABLES dd07v_tab = lt_current_dd07v
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    WHEN 'DTEL'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd04v_wa = ls_current_dd04v
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    WHEN 'STRU'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd02v_wa = ls_current_dd02v
          dd09l_wa = ls_current_dd09v
        TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_current_dd03p
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    WHEN 'TABL'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd02v_wa = ls_current_dd02v
          dd09l_wa = ls_current_dd09v
        TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_current_dd03p
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    WHEN 'TTYP'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TTYP_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd40v_wa = ls_current_dd40v
        TABLES dd42v_tab = lt_current_dd42v
          dd43v_tab = lt_current_dd43v
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
  ENDCASE.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_READ_FAILED'.
    ev_message = 'DDIC read interface failed'.
    ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_gotstate IS NOT INITIAL.
    IF lv_gotstate <> 'A'.
      IF lv_write IS INITIAL
         OR iv_expected_version IS NOT INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'INACTIVE_VERSION_EXISTS'.
        ev_message = 'Inactive DDIC version must be resolved'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR lv_active_state.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_STATE_GET'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          state = 'A'
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_active_state
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_active_state IS NOT INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'INACTIVE_VERSION_EXISTS'.
        ev_message = 'Active object has inactive changes'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR lv_deleted. REFRESH lt_object_refs.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_OBJECT_DELETE'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          authority_check = 'X'
        IMPORTING deleted = lv_deleted
        TABLES objects_with_references = lt_object_refs
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_deleted IS INITIAL
         OR lt_object_refs[] IS NOT INITIAL.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'INACTIVE_RESET_FAILED'.
        ev_message = 'Failed to reset inactive new object'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
      CLEAR lv_gotstate.
    ELSE.
      lv_existing = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_existing = 'X'.
    CASE lv_object_type.
      WHEN 'DOMA'.
        CONCATENATE ls_current_dd01v-as4date
          ls_current_dd01v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'DTEL'.
        CONCATENATE ls_current_dd04v-as4date
          ls_current_dd04v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'STRU'.
        CONCATENATE ls_current_dd02v-as4date
          ls_current_dd02v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'TABL'.
        CONCATENATE ls_current_dd02v-as4date
          ls_current_dd02v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'TTYP'.
        SELECT SINGLE as4date as4time FROM dd40l
          INTO (lv_as4date, lv_as4time)
          WHERE typename = iv_object_name
            AND as4local = 'A'.
        CONCATENATE lv_as4date lv_as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_write IS INITIAL AND lv_existing = 'X'.
    ls_dd01v = ls_current_dd01v.
    lt_dd07v[] = lt_current_dd07v[].
    ls_dd04v = ls_current_dd04v.
    ls_dd02v = ls_current_dd02v.
    ls_dd09v = ls_current_dd09v.
    lt_dd03p[] = lt_current_dd03p[].
    ls_dd40v = ls_current_dd40v.
    lt_dd42v[] = lt_current_dd42v[].
    lt_dd43v[] = lt_current_dd43v[].
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_write IS INITIAL AND lv_existing IS INITIAL.
    ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND'.
    ev_message = 'DDIC object does not exist'.
    ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_object_type = 'TABL' AND lv_existing = 'X'
     AND ls_current_dd02v-tabclass <> 'TRANSP'.
    ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'OBJECT_TYPE_MISMATCH'.
    ev_message = 'Dictionary object is not a transparent table'.
    ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_object_type = 'STRU' AND lv_existing = 'X'
     AND ls_current_dd02v-tabclass <> 'INTTAB'.
    ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'OBJECT_TYPE_MISMATCH'.
    ev_message = 'Dictionary object is not a structure'.
    ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_write = 'X'.
    IF lv_object_type = 'TABL' AND lv_existing = 'X'
       AND lv_append IS INITIAL AND lv_patch IS INITIAL
       AND lv_delete IS INITIAL.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_EXISTS'.
      ev_message = 'Existing transparent tables cannot be replaced'.
      ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_existing = 'X' AND iv_expected_version IS INITIAL.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'EXPECTED_VERSION_REQUIRED'.
      ev_message = 'Existing object requires version token'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_existing = 'X'
       AND iv_expected_version <> lv_current_version.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'VERSION_CONFLICT'.
      ev_message = 'DDIC object changed since it was read'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_existing IS INITIAL
       AND iv_expected_version IS NOT INITIAL.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'VERSION_CONFLICT'.
      ev_message = 'Expected object version no longer exists'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_append = 'X'.
      IF lv_existing IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND'.
        ev_message = 'Transparent table does not exist'.
        ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF lt_dd03p[] IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELDS_REQUIRED'.
        ev_message = 'Fields to append are required'.
        ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR lv_append_count.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dd02l INTO lv_append_count
        WHERE sqltab = iv_object_name
          AND tabclass = 'APPEND' AND as4local = 'A'.
      READ TABLE lt_current_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY fieldname = '.INCLUDE'.
      IF lv_append_count > 0 OR sy-subrc = 0.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'COMPLEX_TABLE_UNSUPPORTED'.
        ev_message = 'Tables with includes or appends are unsupported'.
        ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      lt_append_dd03p[] = lt_dd03p[].
      lt_dd03p[] = lt_current_dd03p[].
      LOOP AT lt_append_dd03p INTO ls_dd03p.
        IF ls_dd03p-fieldname IS INITIAL
           OR ls_dd03p-rollname IS INITIAL
           OR ls_dd03p-fieldname = 'MANDT'
           OR ls_dd03p-keyflag IS NOT INITIAL
           OR ls_dd03p-notnull IS NOT INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'UNSAFE_TABLE_CHANGE'.
          ev_message = 'Only nullable non-key fields may append'.
          ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        READ TABLE lt_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
          WITH KEY fieldname = ls_dd03p-fieldname.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELD_ALREADY_EXISTS'.
          ev_message = 'Transparent table field already exists'.
          ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR: ls_reference_dd04v, lv_reference_state.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_GET'
          EXPORTING name = ls_dd03p-rollname state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_reference_state
            dd04v_wa = ls_reference_dd04v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_reference_state <> 'A'.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND'.
          ev_message = 'Active data element reference not found'.
          ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        ls_dd03p-tabname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd03p-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd03p-position = lines( lt_dd03p ) + 1.
        ls_dd03p-comptype = 'E'.
        APPEND ls_dd03p TO lt_dd03p.
      ENDLOOP.
      ls_dd02v = ls_current_dd02v.
      ls_dd09v = ls_current_dd09v.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_patch = 'X'.
      IF lv_existing IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND'.
        ev_message = 'Transparent table does not exist'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF lt_dd03p[] IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELDS_REQUIRED'.
        ev_message = 'Final table fields are required'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR lv_append_count.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dd02l INTO lv_append_count
        WHERE sqltab = iv_object_name
          AND tabclass = 'APPEND' AND as4local = 'A'.
      READ TABLE lt_current_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY fieldname = '.INCLUDE'.
      IF lv_append_count > 0 OR sy-subrc = 0.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'COMPLEX_TABLE_UNSUPPORTED'.
        ev_message = 'Tables with includes or appends unsupported'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      LOOP AT lt_current_dd03p INTO ls_compare_dd03p.
        IF ls_compare_dd03p-rollname IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'.
          ev_code = 'COMPLEX_TABLE_UNSUPPORTED'.
          ev_message = 'Only direct data element fields supported'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR: lv_current_has_mandt, lv_final_has_mandt,
        lv_changed, lv_key_closed.
      READ TABLE lt_current_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY fieldname = 'MANDT'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_current_has_mandt = 'X'. ENDIF.
      REFRESH lt_checked_dd03p.
      LOOP AT lt_dd03p INTO ls_dd03p.
        lv_index = sy-tabix.
        IF ls_dd03p-fieldname IS INITIAL
           OR ls_dd03p-rollname IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELD_VALUE_INVALID'.
          ev_message = 'Field and data element are required'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        READ TABLE lt_checked_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
          WITH KEY fieldname = ls_dd03p-fieldname.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DUPLICATE_FIELD'.
          ev_message = 'Duplicate final field name'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd03p-keyflag IS INITIAL.
          lv_key_closed = 'X'.
        ELSEIF lv_key_closed = 'X'.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'KEY_ORDER_INVALID'.
          ev_message = 'Key fields must be first'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd03p-keyflag = 'X'
           AND ls_dd03p-notnull IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'KEY_NULLABLE'.
          ev_message = 'Key fields must be not null'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd03p-fieldname = 'MANDT'.
          lv_final_has_mandt = 'X'.
          IF lv_index <> 1 OR ls_dd03p-keyflag <> 'X'
             OR ls_dd03p-notnull <> 'X'
             OR ls_dd03p-rollname <> 'MANDT'.
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'MANDT_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN'.
            ev_message = 'MANDT definition cannot be changed'.
            ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR: ls_reference_dd04v, lv_reference_state.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_GET'
          EXPORTING name = ls_dd03p-rollname state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_reference_state
            dd04v_wa = ls_reference_dd04v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_reference_state <> 'A'.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND'.
          ev_message = 'Active data element reference not found'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        READ TABLE lt_current_dd03p INTO ls_compare_dd03p
          INDEX lv_index.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0
           OR ls_compare_dd03p-fieldname <> ls_dd03p-fieldname
           OR ls_compare_dd03p-rollname <> ls_dd03p-rollname
           OR ls_compare_dd03p-keyflag <> ls_dd03p-keyflag
           OR ls_compare_dd03p-notnull <> ls_dd03p-notnull.
          lv_changed = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
        ls_dd03p-tabname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd03p-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd03p-position = lv_index.
        ls_dd03p-comptype = 'E'.
        MODIFY lt_dd03p FROM ls_dd03p INDEX lv_index.
        APPEND ls_dd03p TO lt_checked_dd03p.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_current_has_mandt <> lv_final_has_mandt.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'MANDT_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN'.
        ev_message = 'MANDT definition cannot be changed'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_current_dd03p LINES lv_current_field_count.
      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_dd03p LINES lv_field_count.
      IF lv_current_field_count <> lv_field_count.
        lv_changed = 'X'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_changed IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'NO_CHANGES'.
        ev_message = 'Final fields equal active definition'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      ls_dd02v = ls_current_dd02v.
      ls_dd09v = ls_current_dd09v.
    ENDIF.
    lv_mode = 'M'.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tadir INTO ls_tadir
      WHERE pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = lv_tadir_type
        AND obj_name = iv_object_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_tadir-devclass <> iv_package.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PACKAGE_CONFLICT'.
      ev_message = 'Existing object belongs to another package'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_mode = 'I'.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_delete = 'X'. lv_mode = 'D'. ENDIF.
    ls_corr_object-objtype = lv_object_type.
    ls_corr_object-objname = iv_object_name.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RS_CORR_INSERT'
      EXPORTING object = ls_corr_object
        object_class = 'DICT' mode = lv_mode
        devclass = iv_package korrnum = iv_request
        use_korrnum_immediatedly = 'X'
        master_language = sy-langu suppress_dialog = 'X'
      IMPORTING korrnum = lv_recorded_request
      EXCEPTIONS cancelled = 1 permission_failure = 2
        unknown_objectclass = 3 OTHERS = 4.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_RECORD_FAILED'.
      MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
        WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4
        INTO ev_message.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_delete = 'X'.
      CLEAR lv_deleted. REFRESH lt_object_refs.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_OBJECT_DELETE'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          authority_check = 'X'
        IMPORTING deleted = lv_deleted
        TABLES objects_with_references = lt_object_refs
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      IF lt_object_refs[] IS NOT INITIAL.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DEPENDENCIES_EXIST'.
        ev_message = 'DDIC object is still referenced'.
        ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_deleted IS INITIAL.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_DELETE_FAILED'.
        MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
          WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4
          INTO ev_message.
        ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
      CLEAR lv_active_state.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_STATE_GET'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          state = 'A'
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_active_state
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_active_state IS NOT INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_DELETE_VERIFY_FAILED'.
        ev_message = 'DDIC object still exists after delete'.
        ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR: ls_dd01v, ls_dd04v, ls_dd02v, ls_dd09v,
        ls_dd40v.
      REFRESH: lt_dd07v, lt_dd03p, lt_dd42v, lt_dd43v.
      ev_status = 'S'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_DELETED'.
      ev_message = 'DDIC object deleted after dependency check'.
      ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    CLEAR lv_rc.
    CASE lv_object_type.
      WHEN 'DOMA'.
        ls_dd01v-domname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd01v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd01v-ddtext = iv_description.
        IF ls_dd01v-outputlen IS INITIAL.
          ls_dd01v-outputlen = ls_dd01v-leng.
        ENDIF.
        LOOP AT lt_dd07v ASSIGNING <ls_value>.
          <ls_value>-domname = iv_object_name.
          <ls_value>-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
          <ls_value>-valpos = sy-tabix.
        ENDLOOP.
        IF lt_dd07v[] IS INITIAL.
          CLEAR ls_dd01v-valexi.
        ELSE.
          ls_dd01v-valexi = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd01v_wa = ls_dd01v
          TABLES dd07v_tab = lt_dd07v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name auth_chk = 'X'
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'DTEL'.
        ls_dd04v-rollname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd04v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd04v-ddtext = iv_description.
        CLEAR: ls_domain_dd01v, lt_domain_dd07v.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_GET'
          EXPORTING name = ls_dd04v-domname state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_active_state
            dd01v_wa = ls_domain_dd01v
          TABLES dd07v_tab = lt_domain_dd07v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_active_state <> 'A'.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND'.
          ev_message = 'Active domain reference not found'.
          ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd04v-reptext IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_text_length = strlen( ls_dd04v-reptext ).
          ls_dd04v-headlen = lv_text_length.
          IF ls_domain_dd01v-outputlen > ls_dd04v-headlen.
            IF ls_domain_dd01v-outputlen > 55.
              ls_dd04v-headlen = 55.
            ELSE.
              ls_dd04v-headlen = ls_domain_dd01v-outputlen.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd04v-scrtext_s IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_text_length = strlen( ls_dd04v-scrtext_s ).
          IF lv_text_length < 10. lv_text_length = 10. ENDIF.
          ls_dd04v-scrlen1 = lv_text_length.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd04v-scrtext_m IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_text_length = strlen( ls_dd04v-scrtext_m ).
          IF lv_text_length < 15. lv_text_length = 15. ENDIF.
          ls_dd04v-scrlen2 = lv_text_length.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd04v-scrtext_l IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_text_length = strlen( ls_dd04v-scrtext_l ).
          IF lv_text_length < 20. lv_text_length = 20. ENDIF.
          ls_dd04v-scrlen3 = lv_text_length.
        ENDIF.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd04v_wa = ls_dd04v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name auth_chk = 'X'
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'STRU'.
        IF lt_dd03p[] IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELDS_REQUIRED'.
          ev_message = 'Structure fields are required'.
          ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR: ls_dd02v, ls_dd09v.
        ls_dd02v-tabname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd02v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd02v-tabclass = 'INTTAB'.
        ls_dd02v-masterlang = sy-langu.
        ls_dd02v-ddtext = iv_description.
        LOOP AT lt_dd03p ASSIGNING <ls_field>.
          <ls_field>-tabname = iv_object_name.
          <ls_field>-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
          <ls_field>-position = sy-tabix.
          <ls_field>-comptype = 'E'.
        ENDLOOP.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd02v_wa = ls_dd02v
            dd09l_wa = ls_dd09v
          TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_dd03p
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name auth_chk = 'X'
              excommit = 'X'
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'TABL'.
        IF lt_dd03p[] IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELDS_REQUIRED'.
          ev_message = 'Transparent table fields are required'.
          ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        ls_dd02v-tabname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd02v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd02v-tabclass = 'TRANSP'.
        ls_dd02v-masterlang = sy-langu.
        ls_dd02v-ddtext = iv_description.
        ls_dd09v-tabname = iv_object_name.
        LOOP AT lt_dd03p ASSIGNING <ls_field>.
          IF lv_append IS INITIAL AND lv_patch IS INITIAL.
            <ls_field>-tabname = iv_object_name.
            <ls_field>-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
            <ls_field>-position = sy-tabix.
            <ls_field>-comptype = 'E'.
            <ls_field>-notnull = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd02v_wa = ls_dd02v
            dd09l_wa = ls_dd09v
          TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_dd03p
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name auth_chk = 'X'
              excommit = 'X'
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'TTYP'.
        CLEAR: lt_dd42v, lt_dd43v.
        ls_dd40v-typename = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd40v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd40v-rowkind = 'S'.
        ls_dd40v-datatype = 'STRU'.
        ls_dd40v-accessmode = 'T'.
        ls_dd40v-keydef = 'D'.
        ls_dd40v-keykind = 'N'.
        ls_dd40v-ddtext = iv_description.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TTYP_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd40v_wa = ls_dd40v
          TABLES dd42v_tab = lt_dd42v dd43v_tab = lt_dd43v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TTYP_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_rc <> 0.
      CLEAR lv_active_state.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_STATE_GET'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          state = 'A'
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_active_state
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    ENDIF.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_active_state IS INITIAL
       AND lv_rc <> 0.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_SAVE_FAILED'.
      MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
        WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4
        INTO ev_message.
      IF ev_message IS INITIAL.
        ev_message = 'DDIC put or activation failed'.
      ENDIF.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    CLEAR: lv_gotstate, lv_current_version.
    CASE lv_object_type.
      WHEN 'DOMA'.
        REFRESH lt_dd07v.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_GET'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate dd01v_wa = ls_dd01v
          TABLES dd07v_tab = lt_dd07v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        CONCATENATE ls_dd01v-as4date ls_dd01v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'DTEL'.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_GET'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate dd04v_wa = ls_dd04v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        CONCATENATE ls_dd04v-as4date ls_dd04v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'STRU'.
        REFRESH lt_dd03p.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate dd02v_wa = ls_dd02v
            dd09l_wa = ls_dd09v
          TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_dd03p
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        CONCATENATE ls_dd02v-as4date ls_dd02v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'TABL'.

                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'NUMBER_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'Invalid table size category'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'BUFALLOW' AND lv_value <> 'N'.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'BUFFER_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'New tables must disable buffering'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'PUFFERUNG'
                 AND lv_value IS NOT INITIAL.
                ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'BUFFER_INVALID'.
                ev_message = 'New tables must disable buffering'.
                ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
              ENDIF.
              IF lv_property = 'CONTFLAG'
                 OR lv_property = 'MAINFLAG'.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
                  OF STRUCTURE ls_dd02v TO <lv_component>.
              ELSE.
                ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
                  OF STRUCTURE ls_dd09v TO <lv_component>.
              ENDIF.
            WHEN OTHERS.
              ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PAYLOAD_INVALID'.
              ev_message = 'Structure has no header payload'.
              ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
          ENDCASE.
        WHEN 'V'.
          IF lv_object_type <> 'DOMA'
             OR ( lv_property <> 'DOMVALUE_L'
             AND lv_property <> 'DOMVALUE_H'
             AND lv_property <> 'DDTEXT' ).
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
            ev_message = 'Fixed value property not allowed'.
            ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          WHILE lines( lt_dd07v ) < lv_index.
            CLEAR ls_dd07v. APPEND ls_dd07v TO lt_dd07v.
          ENDWHILE.
          READ TABLE lt_dd07v ASSIGNING <ls_value>
            INDEX lv_index.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
            OF STRUCTURE <ls_value> TO <lv_component>.
        WHEN 'F'.
          IF lv_object_type <> 'STRU' AND lv_object_type <> 'TABL'.
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
            ev_message = 'Field payload not allowed'.
            ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF lv_property <> 'FIELDNAME'
             AND lv_property <> 'ROLLNAME'
             AND ( lv_object_type <> 'TABL'
               OR ( lv_property <> 'KEYFLAG'
                 AND lv_property <> 'NOTNULL' ) ).
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PROPERTY_NOT_ALLOWED'.
            ev_message = 'Table field property not allowed'.
            ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF lv_property = 'FIELDNAME'
             AND ( lv_value IS INITIAL OR lv_value CN
               'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_' ).
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELD_VALUE_INVALID'.
            ev_message = 'Invalid structure field name'.
            ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF lv_property = 'ROLLNAME'
             AND ( lv_value IS INITIAL OR lv_value CN
               'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_/' ).
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_INVALID'.
            ev_message = 'Invalid data element reference'.
            ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF ( lv_property = 'KEYFLAG'
               OR lv_property = 'NOTNULL' )
             AND lv_value IS NOT INITIAL AND lv_value <> 'X'.
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FLAG_INVALID'.
            ev_message = 'Table field flag must be X or empty'.
            ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          IF lv_object_type = 'TABL'
             AND lv_append IS INITIAL
             AND lv_patch IS INITIAL
             AND lv_property = 'NOTNULL' AND lv_value <> 'X'.
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'NOTNULL_REQUIRED'.
            ev_message = 'Transparent table fields must be not null'.
            ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
          WHILE lines( lt_dd03p ) < lv_index.
            CLEAR ls_dd03p. APPEND ls_dd03p TO lt_dd03p.
          ENDWHILE.
          READ TABLE lt_dd03p ASSIGNING <ls_field>
            INDEX lv_index.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_property
            OF STRUCTURE <ls_field> TO <lv_component>.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PAYLOAD_INVALID'.
          ev_message = 'Unknown DDIC payload row type'.
          ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDCASE.
      IF <lv_component> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PROPERTY_INVALID'.
        ev_message = 'Unknown DDIC payload property'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      <lv_component> = lv_value.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_object_type = 'STRU'.
    lv_tadir_type = 'TABL'.
    lv_state_type = 'TABL'.
  ELSE.
    lv_tadir_type = lv_object_type.
    lv_state_type = lv_object_type.
  ENDIF.
  CLEAR: lv_gotstate, lv_current_version, lv_existing.
  CASE lv_object_type.
    WHEN 'DOMA'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd01v_wa = ls_current_dd01v
        TABLES dd07v_tab = lt_current_dd07v
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    WHEN 'DTEL'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd04v_wa = ls_current_dd04v
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    WHEN 'STRU'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd02v_wa = ls_current_dd02v
          dd09l_wa = ls_current_dd09v
        TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_current_dd03p
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    WHEN 'TABL'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd02v_wa = ls_current_dd02v
          dd09l_wa = ls_current_dd09v
        TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_current_dd03p
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    WHEN 'TTYP'.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TTYP_GET'
        EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'M'
          langu = sy-langu
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate
          dd40v_wa = ls_current_dd40v
        TABLES dd42v_tab = lt_current_dd42v
          dd43v_tab = lt_current_dd43v
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
  ENDCASE.
  IF sy-subrc <> 0.
    ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_READ_FAILED'.
    ev_message = 'DDIC read interface failed'.
    ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_gotstate IS NOT INITIAL.
    IF lv_gotstate <> 'A'.
      IF lv_write IS INITIAL
         OR iv_expected_version IS NOT INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'INACTIVE_VERSION_EXISTS'.
        ev_message = 'Inactive DDIC version must be resolved'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR lv_active_state.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_STATE_GET'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          state = 'A'
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_active_state
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_active_state IS NOT INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'INACTIVE_VERSION_EXISTS'.
        ev_message = 'Active object has inactive changes'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR lv_deleted. REFRESH lt_object_refs.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_OBJECT_DELETE'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          authority_check = 'X'
        IMPORTING deleted = lv_deleted
        TABLES objects_with_references = lt_object_refs
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_deleted IS INITIAL
         OR lt_object_refs[] IS NOT INITIAL.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'INACTIVE_RESET_FAILED'.
        ev_message = 'Failed to reset inactive new object'.
        ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
      CLEAR lv_gotstate.
    ELSE.
      lv_existing = 'X'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_existing = 'X'.
    CASE lv_object_type.
      WHEN 'DOMA'.
        CONCATENATE ls_current_dd01v-as4date
          ls_current_dd01v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'DTEL'.
        CONCATENATE ls_current_dd04v-as4date
          ls_current_dd04v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'STRU'.
        CONCATENATE ls_current_dd02v-as4date
          ls_current_dd02v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'TABL'.
        CONCATENATE ls_current_dd02v-as4date
          ls_current_dd02v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'TTYP'.
        SELECT SINGLE as4date as4time FROM dd40l
          INTO (lv_as4date, lv_as4time)
          WHERE typename = iv_object_name
            AND as4local = 'A'.
        CONCATENATE lv_as4date lv_as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_write IS INITIAL AND lv_existing = 'X'.
    ls_dd01v = ls_current_dd01v.
    lt_dd07v[] = lt_current_dd07v[].
    ls_dd04v = ls_current_dd04v.
    ls_dd02v = ls_current_dd02v.
    ls_dd09v = ls_current_dd09v.
    lt_dd03p[] = lt_current_dd03p[].
    ls_dd40v = ls_current_dd40v.
    lt_dd42v[] = lt_current_dd42v[].
    lt_dd43v[] = lt_current_dd43v[].
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_write IS INITIAL AND lv_existing IS INITIAL.
    ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND'.
    ev_message = 'DDIC object does not exist'.
    ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_object_type = 'TABL' AND lv_existing = 'X'
     AND ls_current_dd02v-tabclass <> 'TRANSP'.
    ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'OBJECT_TYPE_MISMATCH'.
    ev_message = 'Dictionary object is not a transparent table'.
    ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_object_type = 'STRU' AND lv_existing = 'X'
     AND ls_current_dd02v-tabclass <> 'INTTAB'.
    ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'OBJECT_TYPE_MISMATCH'.
    ev_message = 'Dictionary object is not a structure'.
    ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
  ENDIF.
  IF lv_write = 'X'.
    IF lv_object_type = 'TABL' AND lv_existing = 'X'
       AND lv_append IS INITIAL AND lv_patch IS INITIAL
       AND lv_delete IS INITIAL.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_EXISTS'.
      ev_message = 'Existing transparent tables cannot be replaced'.
      ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_existing = 'X' AND iv_expected_version IS INITIAL.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'EXPECTED_VERSION_REQUIRED'.
      ev_message = 'Existing object requires version token'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_existing = 'X'
       AND iv_expected_version <> lv_current_version.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'VERSION_CONFLICT'.
      ev_message = 'DDIC object changed since it was read'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_existing IS INITIAL
       AND iv_expected_version IS NOT INITIAL.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'VERSION_CONFLICT'.
      ev_message = 'Expected object version no longer exists'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_append = 'X'.
      IF lv_existing IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND'.
        ev_message = 'Transparent table does not exist'.
        ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF lt_dd03p[] IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELDS_REQUIRED'.
        ev_message = 'Fields to append are required'.
        ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR lv_append_count.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dd02l INTO lv_append_count
        WHERE sqltab = iv_object_name
          AND tabclass = 'APPEND' AND as4local = 'A'.
      READ TABLE lt_current_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY fieldname = '.INCLUDE'.
      IF lv_append_count > 0 OR sy-subrc = 0.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'COMPLEX_TABLE_UNSUPPORTED'.
        ev_message = 'Tables with includes or appends are unsupported'.
        ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      lt_append_dd03p[] = lt_dd03p[].
      lt_dd03p[] = lt_current_dd03p[].
      LOOP AT lt_append_dd03p INTO ls_dd03p.
        IF ls_dd03p-fieldname IS INITIAL
           OR ls_dd03p-rollname IS INITIAL
           OR ls_dd03p-fieldname = 'MANDT'
           OR ls_dd03p-keyflag IS NOT INITIAL
           OR ls_dd03p-notnull IS NOT INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'UNSAFE_TABLE_CHANGE'.
          ev_message = 'Only nullable non-key fields may append'.
          ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        READ TABLE lt_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
          WITH KEY fieldname = ls_dd03p-fieldname.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELD_ALREADY_EXISTS'.
          ev_message = 'Transparent table field already exists'.
          ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR: ls_reference_dd04v, lv_reference_state.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_GET'
          EXPORTING name = ls_dd03p-rollname state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_reference_state
            dd04v_wa = ls_reference_dd04v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_reference_state <> 'A'.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND'.
          ev_message = 'Active data element reference not found'.
          ev_version = '1.5'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        ls_dd03p-tabname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd03p-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd03p-position = lines( lt_dd03p ) + 1.
        ls_dd03p-comptype = 'E'.
        APPEND ls_dd03p TO lt_dd03p.
      ENDLOOP.
      ls_dd02v = ls_current_dd02v.
      ls_dd09v = ls_current_dd09v.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_patch = 'X'.
      IF lv_existing IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_NOT_FOUND'.
        ev_message = 'Transparent table does not exist'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF lt_dd03p[] IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELDS_REQUIRED'.
        ev_message = 'Final table fields are required'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR lv_append_count.
      SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dd02l INTO lv_append_count
        WHERE sqltab = iv_object_name
          AND tabclass = 'APPEND' AND as4local = 'A'.
      READ TABLE lt_current_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY fieldname = '.INCLUDE'.
      IF lv_append_count > 0 OR sy-subrc = 0.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'COMPLEX_TABLE_UNSUPPORTED'.
        ev_message = 'Tables with includes or appends unsupported'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      LOOP AT lt_current_dd03p INTO ls_compare_dd03p.
        IF ls_compare_dd03p-rollname IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'.
          ev_code = 'COMPLEX_TABLE_UNSUPPORTED'.
          ev_message = 'Only direct data element fields supported'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR: lv_current_has_mandt, lv_final_has_mandt,
        lv_changed, lv_key_closed.
      READ TABLE lt_current_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
        WITH KEY fieldname = 'MANDT'.
      IF sy-subrc = 0. lv_current_has_mandt = 'X'. ENDIF.
      REFRESH lt_checked_dd03p.
      LOOP AT lt_dd03p INTO ls_dd03p.
        lv_index = sy-tabix.
        IF ls_dd03p-fieldname IS INITIAL
           OR ls_dd03p-rollname IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELD_VALUE_INVALID'.
          ev_message = 'Field and data element are required'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        READ TABLE lt_checked_dd03p TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS
          WITH KEY fieldname = ls_dd03p-fieldname.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DUPLICATE_FIELD'.
          ev_message = 'Duplicate final field name'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd03p-keyflag IS INITIAL.
          lv_key_closed = 'X'.
        ELSEIF lv_key_closed = 'X'.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'KEY_ORDER_INVALID'.
          ev_message = 'Key fields must be first'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd03p-keyflag = 'X'
           AND ls_dd03p-notnull IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'KEY_NULLABLE'.
          ev_message = 'Key fields must be not null'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd03p-fieldname = 'MANDT'.
          lv_final_has_mandt = 'X'.
          IF lv_index <> 1 OR ls_dd03p-keyflag <> 'X'
             OR ls_dd03p-notnull <> 'X'
             OR ls_dd03p-rollname <> 'MANDT'.
            ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'MANDT_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN'.
            ev_message = 'MANDT definition cannot be changed'.
            ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR: ls_reference_dd04v, lv_reference_state.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_GET'
          EXPORTING name = ls_dd03p-rollname state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_reference_state
            dd04v_wa = ls_reference_dd04v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_reference_state <> 'A'.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND'.
          ev_message = 'Active data element reference not found'.
          ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        READ TABLE lt_current_dd03p INTO ls_compare_dd03p
          INDEX lv_index.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0
           OR ls_compare_dd03p-fieldname <> ls_dd03p-fieldname
           OR ls_compare_dd03p-rollname <> ls_dd03p-rollname
           OR ls_compare_dd03p-keyflag <> ls_dd03p-keyflag
           OR ls_compare_dd03p-notnull <> ls_dd03p-notnull.
          lv_changed = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
        ls_dd03p-tabname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd03p-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd03p-position = lv_index.
        ls_dd03p-comptype = 'E'.
        MODIFY lt_dd03p FROM ls_dd03p INDEX lv_index.
        APPEND ls_dd03p TO lt_checked_dd03p.
      ENDLOOP.
      IF lv_current_has_mandt <> lv_final_has_mandt.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'MANDT_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN'.
        ev_message = 'MANDT definition cannot be changed'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_current_dd03p LINES lv_current_field_count.
      DESCRIBE TABLE lt_dd03p LINES lv_field_count.
      IF lv_current_field_count <> lv_field_count.
        lv_changed = 'X'.
      ENDIF.
      IF lv_changed IS INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'NO_CHANGES'.
        ev_message = 'Final fields equal active definition'.
        ev_version = '1.6'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      ls_dd02v = ls_current_dd02v.
      ls_dd09v = ls_current_dd09v.
    ENDIF.
    lv_mode = 'M'.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM tadir INTO ls_tadir
      WHERE pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = lv_tadir_type
        AND obj_name = iv_object_name.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND ls_tadir-devclass <> iv_package.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'PACKAGE_CONFLICT'.
      ev_message = 'Existing object belongs to another package'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      lv_mode = 'I'.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_delete = 'X'. lv_mode = 'D'. ENDIF.
    ls_corr_object-objtype = lv_object_type.
    ls_corr_object-objname = iv_object_name.
    CALL FUNCTION 'RS_CORR_INSERT'
      EXPORTING object = ls_corr_object
        object_class = 'DICT' mode = lv_mode
        devclass = iv_package korrnum = iv_request
        use_korrnum_immediatedly = 'X'
        master_language = sy-langu suppress_dialog = 'X'
      IMPORTING korrnum = lv_recorded_request
      EXCEPTIONS cancelled = 1 permission_failure = 2
        unknown_objectclass = 3 OTHERS = 4.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'TRANSPORT_RECORD_FAILED'.
      MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
        WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4
        INTO ev_message.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    IF lv_delete = 'X'.
      CLEAR lv_deleted. REFRESH lt_object_refs.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_OBJECT_DELETE'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          authority_check = 'X'
        IMPORTING deleted = lv_deleted
        TABLES objects_with_references = lt_object_refs
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      IF lt_object_refs[] IS NOT INITIAL.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DEPENDENCIES_EXIST'.
        ev_message = 'DDIC object is still referenced'.
        ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_deleted IS INITIAL.
        ROLLBACK WORK.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_DELETE_FAILED'.
        MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
          WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4
          INTO ev_message.
        ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
      CLEAR lv_active_state.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_STATE_GET'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          state = 'A'
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_active_state
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_active_state IS NOT INITIAL.
        ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_DELETE_VERIFY_FAILED'.
        ev_message = 'DDIC object still exists after delete'.
        ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
      ENDIF.
      CLEAR: ls_dd01v, ls_dd04v, ls_dd02v, ls_dd09v,
        ls_dd40v.
      REFRESH: lt_dd07v, lt_dd03p, lt_dd42v, lt_dd43v.
      ev_status = 'S'. ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_DELETED'.
      ev_message = 'DDIC object deleted after dependency check'.
      ev_version = '1.4'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    CLEAR lv_rc.
    CASE lv_object_type.
      WHEN 'DOMA'.
        ls_dd01v-domname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd01v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd01v-ddtext = iv_description.
        IF ls_dd01v-outputlen IS INITIAL.
          ls_dd01v-outputlen = ls_dd01v-leng.
        ENDIF.
        LOOP AT lt_dd07v ASSIGNING <ls_value>.
          <ls_value>-domname = iv_object_name.
          <ls_value>-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
          <ls_value>-valpos = sy-tabix.
        ENDLOOP.
        IF lt_dd07v[] IS INITIAL.
          CLEAR ls_dd01v-valexi.
        ELSE.
          ls_dd01v-valexi = 'X'.
        ENDIF.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd01v_wa = ls_dd01v
          TABLES dd07v_tab = lt_dd07v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name auth_chk = 'X'
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'DTEL'.
        ls_dd04v-rollname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd04v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd04v-ddtext = iv_description.
        CLEAR: ls_domain_dd01v, lt_domain_dd07v.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_GET'
          EXPORTING name = ls_dd04v-domname state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_active_state
            dd01v_wa = ls_domain_dd01v
          TABLES dd07v_tab = lt_domain_dd07v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_active_state <> 'A'.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND'.
          ev_message = 'Active domain reference not found'.
          ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd04v-reptext IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_text_length = strlen( ls_dd04v-reptext ).
          ls_dd04v-headlen = lv_text_length.
          IF ls_domain_dd01v-outputlen > ls_dd04v-headlen.
            IF ls_domain_dd01v-outputlen > 55.
              ls_dd04v-headlen = 55.
            ELSE.
              ls_dd04v-headlen = ls_domain_dd01v-outputlen.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd04v-scrtext_s IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_text_length = strlen( ls_dd04v-scrtext_s ).
          IF lv_text_length < 10. lv_text_length = 10. ENDIF.
          ls_dd04v-scrlen1 = lv_text_length.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd04v-scrtext_m IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_text_length = strlen( ls_dd04v-scrtext_m ).
          IF lv_text_length < 15. lv_text_length = 15. ENDIF.
          ls_dd04v-scrlen2 = lv_text_length.
        ENDIF.
        IF ls_dd04v-scrtext_l IS NOT INITIAL.
          lv_text_length = strlen( ls_dd04v-scrtext_l ).
          IF lv_text_length < 20. lv_text_length = 20. ENDIF.
          ls_dd04v-scrlen3 = lv_text_length.
        ENDIF.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd04v_wa = ls_dd04v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name auth_chk = 'X'
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'STRU'.
        IF lt_dd03p[] IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELDS_REQUIRED'.
          ev_message = 'Structure fields are required'.
          ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        CLEAR: ls_dd02v, ls_dd09v.
        ls_dd02v-tabname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd02v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd02v-tabclass = 'INTTAB'.
        ls_dd02v-masterlang = sy-langu.
        ls_dd02v-ddtext = iv_description.
        LOOP AT lt_dd03p ASSIGNING <ls_field>.
          <ls_field>-tabname = iv_object_name.
          <ls_field>-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
          <ls_field>-position = sy-tabix.
          <ls_field>-comptype = 'E'.
        ENDLOOP.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd02v_wa = ls_dd02v
            dd09l_wa = ls_dd09v
          TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_dd03p
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name auth_chk = 'X'
              excommit = 'X'
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'TABL'.
        IF lt_dd03p[] IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'FIELDS_REQUIRED'.
          ev_message = 'Transparent table fields are required'.
          ev_version = '1.3'. RETURN.
        ENDIF.
        ls_dd02v-tabname = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd02v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd02v-tabclass = 'TRANSP'.
        ls_dd02v-masterlang = sy-langu.
        ls_dd02v-ddtext = iv_description.
        ls_dd09v-tabname = iv_object_name.
        LOOP AT lt_dd03p ASSIGNING <ls_field>.
          IF lv_append IS INITIAL AND lv_patch IS INITIAL.
            <ls_field>-tabname = iv_object_name.
            <ls_field>-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
            <ls_field>-position = sy-tabix.
            <ls_field>-comptype = 'E'.
            <ls_field>-notnull = 'X'.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd02v_wa = ls_dd02v
            dd09l_wa = ls_dd09v
          TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_dd03p
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name auth_chk = 'X'
              excommit = 'X'
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'TTYP'.
        CLEAR: lt_dd42v, lt_dd43v.
        ls_dd40v-typename = iv_object_name.
        ls_dd40v-ddlanguage = sy-langu.
        ls_dd40v-rowkind = 'S'.
        ls_dd40v-datatype = 'STRU'.
        ls_dd40v-accessmode = 'T'.
        ls_dd40v-keydef = 'D'.
        ls_dd40v-keykind = 'N'.
        ls_dd40v-ddtext = iv_description.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TTYP_PUT'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name dd40v_wa = ls_dd40v
          TABLES dd42v_tab = lt_dd42v dd43v_tab = lt_dd43v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TTYP_ACTIVATE'
            EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name
            IMPORTING rc = lv_rc EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        ENDIF.
    ENDCASE.
    IF sy-subrc = 0 AND lv_rc <> 0.
      CLEAR lv_active_state.
      CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_STATE_GET'
        EXPORTING type = lv_state_type name = lv_ddic_name
          state = 'A'
        IMPORTING gotstate = lv_active_state
        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
    ENDIF.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_active_state IS INITIAL
       AND lv_rc <> 0.
      ROLLBACK WORK.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'DDIC_SAVE_FAILED'.
      MESSAGE ID sy-msgid TYPE 'S' NUMBER sy-msgno
        WITH sy-msgv1 sy-msgv2 sy-msgv3 sy-msgv4
        INTO ev_message.
      IF ev_message IS INITIAL.
        ev_message = 'DDIC put or activation failed'.
      ENDIF.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
    CLEAR: lv_gotstate, lv_current_version.
    CASE lv_object_type.
      WHEN 'DOMA'.
        REFRESH lt_dd07v.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DOMA_GET'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate dd01v_wa = ls_dd01v
          TABLES dd07v_tab = lt_dd07v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        CONCATENATE ls_dd01v-as4date ls_dd01v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'DTEL'.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_DTEL_GET'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate dd04v_wa = ls_dd04v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        CONCATENATE ls_dd04v-as4date ls_dd04v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'STRU'.
        REFRESH lt_dd03p.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate dd02v_wa = ls_dd02v
            dd09l_wa = ls_dd09v
          TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_dd03p
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        CONCATENATE ls_dd02v-as4date ls_dd02v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'TABL'.
        REFRESH lt_dd03p.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TABL_GET'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate dd02v_wa = ls_dd02v
            dd09l_wa = ls_dd09v
          TABLES dd03p_tab = lt_dd03p
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        CONCATENATE ls_dd02v-as4date ls_dd02v-as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
      WHEN 'TTYP'.
        CALL FUNCTION 'DDIF_TTYP_GET'
          EXPORTING name = lv_ddic_name state = 'A'
            langu = sy-langu
          IMPORTING gotstate = lv_gotstate dd40v_wa = ls_dd40v
          TABLES dd42v_tab = lt_dd42v dd43v_tab = lt_dd43v
          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.
        SELECT SINGLE as4date as4time FROM dd40l
          INTO (lv_as4date, lv_as4time)
          WHERE typename = iv_object_name
            AND as4local = 'A'.
        CONCATENATE lv_as4date lv_as4time
          INTO lv_current_version.
    ENDCASE.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_gotstate <> 'A'.
      ev_status = 'E'. ev_code = 'VERIFY_FAILED'.
      ev_message = 'Activated DDIC object could not be read'.
      ev_version = '1.2'. RETURN.
    ENDIF.
  ENDIF.
  SELECT SINGLE * FROM tadir INTO ls_tadir
    WHERE pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = lv_tadir_type
      AND obj_name = iv_object_name.
  REFRESH it_source.
  add_payload 'M' '1' 'PACKAGE' ls_tadir-devclass.
  add_payload 'M' '1' 'VERSION' lv_current_version.
  add_payload 'M' '1' 'REQUEST' lv_recorded_request.
  CASE lv_object_type.
    WHEN 'DOMA'.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DOMNAME' ls_dd01v-domname.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DDTEXT' ls_dd01v-ddtext.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DATATYPE' ls_dd01v-datatype.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'LENG' ls_dd01v-leng.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'OUTPUTLEN' ls_dd01v-outputlen.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DECIMALS' ls_dd01v-decimals.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'LOWERCASE' ls_dd01v-lowercase.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'SIGNFLAG' ls_dd01v-signflag.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'ENTITYTAB' ls_dd01v-entitytab.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'CONVEXIT' ls_dd01v-convexit.
      LOOP AT lt_dd07v INTO ls_dd07v.
        lv_index = sy-tabix.
        add_payload 'V' lv_index 'DOMVALUE_L'
          ls_dd07v-domvalue_l.
        add_payload 'V' lv_index 'DOMVALUE_H'
          ls_dd07v-domvalue_h.
        add_payload 'V' lv_index 'DDTEXT' ls_dd07v-ddtext.
      ENDLOOP.
    WHEN 'DTEL'.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'ROLLNAME' ls_dd04v-rollname.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DDTEXT' ls_dd04v-ddtext.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DOMNAME' ls_dd04v-domname.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'REPTEXT' ls_dd04v-reptext.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'SCRTEXT_S' ls_dd04v-scrtext_s.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'SCRTEXT_M' ls_dd04v-scrtext_m.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'SCRTEXT_L' ls_dd04v-scrtext_l.
    WHEN 'STRU'.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'TABNAME' ls_dd02v-tabname.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DDTEXT' ls_dd02v-ddtext.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'TABCLASS' ls_dd02v-tabclass.
      LOOP AT lt_dd03p INTO ls_dd03p.
        lv_index = sy-tabix.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'FIELDNAME'
          ls_dd03p-fieldname.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'POSITION'
          ls_dd03p-position.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'ROLLNAME'
          ls_dd03p-rollname.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'DDTEXT' ls_dd03p-ddtext.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'DATATYPE' ls_dd03p-datatype.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'LENG' ls_dd03p-leng.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'COMPTYPE' ls_dd03p-comptype.
      ENDLOOP.
    WHEN 'TABL'.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'TABNAME' ls_dd02v-tabname.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DDTEXT' ls_dd02v-ddtext.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'TABCLASS' ls_dd02v-tabclass.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'CONTFLAG' ls_dd02v-contflag.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'MAINFLAG' ls_dd02v-mainflag.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'TABKAT' ls_dd09v-tabkat.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'TABART' ls_dd09v-tabart.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'BUFALLOW' ls_dd09v-bufallow.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'PUFFERUNG' ls_dd09v-pufferung.
      LOOP AT lt_dd03p INTO ls_dd03p.
        lv_index = sy-tabix.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'FIELDNAME'
          ls_dd03p-fieldname.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'POSITION'
          ls_dd03p-position.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'ROLLNAME'
          ls_dd03p-rollname.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'DDTEXT' ls_dd03p-ddtext.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'DATATYPE' ls_dd03p-datatype.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'LENG' ls_dd03p-leng.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'COMPTYPE' ls_dd03p-comptype.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'KEYFLAG'
          ls_dd03p-keyflag.
        add_payload 'F' lv_index 'NOTNULL'
          ls_dd03p-notnull.
      ENDLOOP.
    WHEN 'TTYP'.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'TYPENAME' ls_dd40v-typename.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DDTEXT' ls_dd40v-ddtext.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'ROWTYPE' ls_dd40v-rowtype.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'ROWKIND' ls_dd40v-rowkind.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'DATATYPE' ls_dd40v-datatype.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'ACCESSMODE' ls_dd40v-accessmode.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'KEYDEF' ls_dd40v-keydef.
      add_payload 'H' '1' 'KEYKIND' ls_dd40v-keykind.
  ENDCASE.
  ev_status = 'S'.
  IF lv_write = 'X'.
    ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_SAVED'.
    ev_message = 'DDIC object saved activated and verified'.
  ELSE.
    ev_code = 'DDIC_OBJECT_READ'.
    ev_message = 'DDIC object read successfully'.
  ENDIF.
  ev_version = '1.6'.





ENDFUNCTION.
